// This is your Prisma schema file.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  email     String   @unique
  password  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  links     Link[]
}

model Link {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  shortCode   String    @unique
  originalUrl String
  password    String?
  expires     DateTime?
  clicks      Int       @default(0)
  userId      Int?
  user        User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  clicksLog   Click[]
}

model Click {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  linkId    Int
  ip        String?
  country   String?
  referrer  String?
  userAgent String?
  timestamp DateTime @default(now())
  link      Link     @relation(fields: [linkId], references: [id])
}

POST /auth/register, /auth/login

POST /shorten {originalUrl, customCode?, password?, expires (ISO date)? } -> generate shortCode if not custom, check unique, create Link, return shortUrl = http://localhost:3001/{shortCode} or env FRONTEND_URL

GET /api/analytics/:shortCode -> require auth, check owner, return clicks, list clicks summary (group by date, top countries)

GET /api/links -> require auth, list user.links with clicks, shortCode etc.

Use nanoid(6) for shortCode.

Custom: if provided, check if exists, if not use.

Hash password for link.

For expires, parse date.

Rate limit on /shorten 10/min ip, /s/: 100/min ip.

JWT_SECRET from env.

CORS origin http://localhost:5173

Prevent abuse.

Test endpoints with curl or something.

Verify with bash commands.

Update Prisma if needed.

Start with auth, then shorten, redirect, etc.

Run npm run dev after changes, check no errors.
